_comment: BCP 47 tag -> the wording put into the prompt where <output_language> appears. A tag not listed here is injected verbatim, so an unlisted language still works and an old config holding a plain language name keeps behaving as it did. Naming both the endonym and the English name is deliberate: 'zh-Hant' alone is a weaker instruction to a model than the language's own name.
